name: Message Function 16 Code
definition: Identifies the type of process related to a financial initiation and financial response message.|ISO 8583 MTI

ADVC.name: Advice
ADVC.definition: Advice indicates where the sender informs the receiver of an activity that has been taken that requires a response.

CAAD.name: Capture Advice
CAAD.definition: Advice about the capture of an activity already performed (response expected).

CANO.name: Capture Notification
CANO.definition: Notification about the capture of an activity already performed (no response expected).
